name: NE HODI NA MEHMAT NOCH'JU
source:
The myth of the so-called “Quantum Demidovich,” said to exist somewhere deep within the mathematics department. A book containing the solutions to every exam in every mathematical discipline, changing its contents to match the preferences of any specific professor, written in a language understandable only to those who have survived every semester’s exams.
Terrified of expulsion, losing his scholarship, and everything that gives meaning to his daily life, Veniamin decides the risk is worth taking in order to obtain this holy grail... But what consequences will follow?
translation:
据说存在于数学系深处的所谓“量子杰米多维奇”的神话。这本书包含了每个数学学科的每次考试的答案，改变了内容以符合任何特定教授的偏好，并且以只有通过每学期考试的人才能理解的语言编写。
由于害怕被开除、失去奖学金以及一切赋予他日常生活意义的东西，维尼阿明决定为了获得这个圣杯而冒这个风险……但随之而来的后果是什么？
